snippet.title: Hardlight Teaser
snippet.description:
Hardlight is the new strategy, tower defense video game from Sonderian Games. Defend against dark forces created by an experiment gone catastrophically wrong. Are you ready to extinguish the dark forces before they extinguish the precious light?  Wishlist Hardlight now on Steam.

Subscribe to our channel to get the latest updates:  @Sonderian  
https://www.sonderian.com/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386770/Hardlight
